item.title: University of Manitoba - Student Success Week
item.description: March 2-6, 2026 is the Student Success Week at UM. This week, learn about and connect with student supports, resources, and activities that can help you stay motivated and move forward in your studies, especially during a time of year when many may be experiencing academic or personal challenges.

item.title: University of Manitoba - Artificial Intelligence
item.description: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming research, teaching and university operations. At UM, we primarily focus on generative AI, which creates new content like text, images, audio or code based on patterns in large datasets (per Government of Canada guidance).AI offers benefits across higher education from improving accessibility to streamlining operations, but also carries risks such as bias, privacy concerns and misinformation. Our guiding principles help ensure AI is used responsibly

item.title: University of Manitoba - University of Manitoba Employees Scholarship - UMES
item.description: The University of Manitoba Employees Scholarship (UMES) is available to the spouse or dependent children of University of Manitoba employees or retired former employees.
